title: 70 days to election: Anambra NDC plans mega rallies for one million votes as Oluwadara Kehinde drives local agenda
summary: With 70 days until 16 January 2027, the NDC Anambra chapter has planned mega rallies and a major town hall to mobilise over one million votes for the Obi/Kwankwaso ticket. Nationally, the party continues transparent engagement. Locally, Oluwadara Kehinde (Akan) advances people-centred representation focused on youth, agriculture, education, accountability and infrastructure in Yewa North / Imeko-Afon. Share the national momentum and the local agenda. A New Nigeria is Possible.

title: 71 days to election: NDC slams Tinubu’s fresh $7.7bn loan request as Oluwadara Kehinde advances local agenda
summary: With 71 days until 16 January 2027, the NDC National Presidential Campaign Council criticised President Tinubu’s latest request for a $7.7 billion (approx. ₦10.79 trillion) external loan to finance the 2026 budget deficit, calling it part of a “one week, new loan” pattern and accusing the National Assembly of rubber-stamping borrowings. The party urged Nigerians to use the ballot for accountability and support Peter Obi and Kwankwaso. Locally, Oluwadara Kehinde (Akan) continues people-centred mobilisation in Yewa North / Imeko-Afon. Share the national demand for fiscal responsibility with the local agenda. A New Nigeria is Possible.

title: 72 days to election: Share Joga-Iboro ward engagement as Oluwadara Kehinde continues ground mobilisation
summary: With 72 days until 16 January 2027, Oluwadara Kehinde (Akan) continues ward-level engagement across Yewa North / Imeko-Afon, including recent work in Joga-Iboro. Nationally, the NDC maintains transparency and Peter Obi’s nationwide push on unity, security, education and productivity. Share the local images and the national vision. A New Nigeria is Possible.

title: 73 days to election: Promote Oluwadara Kehinde’s people-centred agenda as NDC maintains momentum
summary: With 73 days until 16 January 2027, supporters are encouraged to engage friends and family with Oluwadara Kehinde (Akan)’s homegrown, transparent agenda for Yewa North / Imeko-Afon — youth empowerment, agriculture, education, accountable representation and infrastructure. Nationally, Peter Obi and the NDC continue nationwide engagement on unity, security and productivity while upholding transparency. A New Nigeria is Possible.

title: 74 days to election: Peter Obi’s nationwide town halls and emergency agenda pair with Oluwadara Kehinde’s local mobilisation
summary: With 74 days until 16 January 2027, Peter Obi continues nationwide engagement, recently outlining emergency measures on unity, insecurity, education, corruption, hunger, health and electricity at town halls in Abakaliki and Enugu alongside Kwankwaso. Nationally, the NDC maintains transparency after its N8.5bn disclosure. Locally, Oluwadara Kehinde (Akan) advances people-centred representation through ward-level work in Yewa North and Imeko-Afon. Share the national vision and the local agenda. A New Nigeria is Possible.

title: 75 days to election: NDC transparency and Peter Obi’s Enugu town hall pair with Oluwadara Kehinde’s local agenda
summary: With 75 days until the 16 January 2027 election, the NDC continues to demonstrate accountability after disclosing N8.529 billion raised and N2.402 billion spent. Peter Obi and Kwankwaso recently held town hall meetings in Enugu and Ebonyi, stressing unity, security, health, education and pulling people out of poverty. Locally, Oluwadara Kehinde (Akan) advances people-centred representation focused on youth empowerment, agriculture and value addition, education and skills, accountable representation, and infrastructure across Yewa North and Imeko-Afon. Share the national vision and the local agenda. A New Nigeria is Possible.

title: 76 days to election: Peter Obi engages in Yenagoa as Oluwadara Kehinde drives local mobilisation in Yewa North / Imeko-Afon
summary: With 76 days until the 16 January 2027 election, Peter Obi continues nationwide engagement, recently outlining port development, youth employment, security and healthcare plans in Yenagoa alongside NDC leaders. Nationally, the NDC maintains its transparency standard after disclosing N8.5bn income. Locally, Oluwadara Kehinde (Akan) advances people-centred representation through ward-level work. Share the national vision and the local agenda for a New Nigeria.

title: 77 days to election: NDC transparency and Oluwadara Kehinde’s people-centred agenda in focus
summary: With 77 days until the 16 January 2027 election, the NDC continues to set a standard of accountability after disclosing N8.5 billion raised and N2.4 billion spent. Peter Obi and the National Campaign Council push for a new productive Nigeria. Locally, Oluwadara Kehinde (Akan) advances youth empowerment, agriculture, education, accountable representation and infrastructure across Yewa North and Imeko-Afon. Share the agenda and invite friends to join.

title: 78 days to election: NDC shows transparency with N8.5bn disclosure — Oluwadara Kehinde continues ground work
summary: With 78 days until the 16 January 2027 election, the NDC has publicly disclosed raising N8.529 billion and spending N2.402 billion in seven months, challenging other parties on accountability. Peter Obi and the National Campaign Council remain active. Oluwadara Kehinde (Akan) continues people-centred mobilisation across Yewa North and Imeko-Afon. Share the national commitment to transparency and the local agenda.

title: NDC discloses N8.5bn income, N2.4bn spending in seven months — challenges other parties to open books
summary: At its NEC meeting, the Nigeria Democratic Congress disclosed generating N8.529 billion from nomination forms, dues, levies and contributions, while spending N2.402 billion. National Chairman Moses Cleopas and Treasurer Peter Onigah framed the early disclosure as a commitment to transparency and accountability. Pair this national standard with Oluwadara Kehinde (Akan)’s focus on accountable representation for Yewa North / Imeko-Afon.

title: Peter Obi declares war on corruption, promises measurable results from day one
summary: At the NDC Campaign Council inauguration and secretariat unveiling, Peter Obi vowed an uncompromising war on the diversion of public funds, emergency measures on security, agriculture, education, healthcare and electricity, and measurable improvements from the first day rather than blame. He and Kwankwaso called for a new productive Nigeria founded on fairness, justice, equity and inclusion. Pair this national commitment with Oluwadara Kehinde (Akan)’s accountable representation agenda in Yewa North / Imeko-Afon.

title: Peter Obi: A New and Productive Nigeria is Possible — Nigeria Will Be OK after Campaign Council inauguration
summary: Following the inauguration of the NDC National Campaign Council, Peter Obi stated that a new and productive Nigeria is possible and Nigeria will be OK. He noted that over 140 million Nigerians are multidimensionally poor, highlighted widespread corruption, insecurity, unemployment and inequality, and criticised the current administration’s failure to translate increased revenue into productivity. Obi and Kwankwaso called on Nigerians to join the crusade of rebuilding the nation on fairness, justice, equity, productivity and inclusion.

title: NDC inaugurates National Campaign Council — Dickson chairs, Obi co-chairs, certificates of return presented
summary: The Nigeria Democratic Congress inaugurated its National Campaign Council in Abuja. Senator Henry Seriake Dickson is Chairman, Peter Obi is Co-Chairman, Rabiu Musa Kwankwaso is Co-Vice Chairman. The council coordinates campaigns for all NDC candidates. Certificates of Return were presented. Pair this national step with Oluwadara Kehinde (Akan)’s ongoing mobilisation in Yewa North / Imeko-Afon. A New Nigeria is Possible.
